content: BSVibe is implemented as a unified monorepo with a FastAPI backend and Next.js PWA. The README documents Docker Compose startup, backend health probe, PWA entrypoint, and test commands, so source-derived RAG should include both implementation and operational setup context.
title: BSVibe monorepo layout and local stack

content: KnowledgeFactory is the central per-workspace/per-region constructor. It roots every vault at region/workspace_id, exposes workspace-scoped Vault and GardenWriter objects, and constructs the workspace-scoped retriever used by runtime components. This makes workspace scoping a first-class RAG metadata requirement.
title: KnowledgeFactory binds knowledge to workspace and region

content: CanonConceptRetriever extracts candidate tags from work signals, resolves them through the canonicalization index, and returns active concept display statements. It is bounded, workspace-scoped, graceful-empty, and never raises into verification, so promoted concepts should be separated from raw notes in the dataset.
title: Canonical concept retrieval uses promoted active concepts only

content: ResolvedDecisionsRetriever reads decision_resolution notes from garden/seedling, filters out tombstoned notes, matches signal tokens against question, answer, and intent text, and emits prior decision statements. This confirms that decision memories are a concrete source type for BSVibe RAG.
title: Resolved decisions are retrieved from settled garden notes

content: NegativePatternRetriever reads negative_pattern garden notes emitted when a founder discards a deliverable with a reason. It surfaces relevant avoid guidance by signal overlap, which means rejected approaches should be modeled as their own retrieval source instead of mixed into generic notes.
title: Negative patterns preserve founder rejection feedback

content: CompositeCanonRetriever combines several CanonRetriever sources, dedupes statements, preserves source order, caps total output, and degrades when one source fails. The RAG dataset should therefore track note_type/source_type so retrieval can rank canonical concepts before decisions and negative patterns.
title: Composite retriever merges multiple knowledge sources behind one protocol

content: The agent runtime builds a workspace-scoped KnowledgeFactory retriever, optionally composes SemanticNoteRetriever when embeddings are configured, injects retriever into executor/native loops, and routes knowledge_only frames to KnowledgeAnswerOrchestrator. This proves RAG context is consumed at runtime, not only stored.
title: Agent runtime wires workspace retriever into execution and knowledge-only route

content: Worker runtime constructs SettleWorker with KnowledgeSettleSink, entity extractor fallback, garden promoter factory, and note embedding hook. This is the ingestion path that turns workflow activity into vault knowledge and vector-searchable notes.
title: Settle worker writes vault notes, promotes concepts, and embeds notes

content: IngestCompiler splits seed items into chunks, emits progress events, finds related context once per chunk, plans updates with an LLM, and writes notes. The code explicitly warns not to hoist related-context lookup outside the chunk loop, so cleaned data should retain chunk-level provenance.
title: IngestCompiler compiles imported seed content per chunk

content: The chunking module uses a conservative default char budget, reserves model context for prompts/output, caps Ollama budgets, truncates oversized items, and separates partitioning from retrieval. This supports RAG data cleaning rules around chunk size and local-model constraints.
title: Chunking budget protects local LLM ingestion

content: SemanticNoteRetriever embeds incoming signals and searches a NoteVectorBackend, while PgNoteVectorBackend stores/searches note_embeddings by workspace_id and embedding_model using pgvector cosine distance. Semantic search is auxiliary, capped, similarity-filtered, and workspace-scoped.
title: Semantic note retrieval searches pgvector note embeddings

content: The PWA knowledge API calls /api/v1/inside endpoints for canonical concepts, observations, graph data, concept detail, retract/correct actions, and undo. This defines the user-facing source categories that the RAG dataset should preserve for inspection and correction workflows.
title: PWA Knowledge API exposes concepts, observations, graph, retract, and correct

content: KnowledgeGraphView renders a full-screen force-directed graph over /api/v1/inside data, supports type/community color modes, opens concept detail in an inspector, and tracks local retract/correct visual state until backend refresh. This confirms graph and correction metadata matter for analysis.
title: Knowledge graph view presents ontology nodes and inspector actions

content: The knowledge MCP domain tools define schemas for search_knowledge, get_note, get_graph_context, list_recent, list_by_tag, list_tags, browse_communities, browse_entity, and create_note. RAG data should preserve tool-facing fields like path, preview, tags, graph context, and audit source.
title: MCP domain tools define search, graph, tag, and create-note surfaces

content: The B13 glue test resolves a decision through the API, drains SettleWorker into the vault, constructs a fresh KnowledgeFactory retriever for a second run, and asserts the prior decision appears in both first-turn LLM messages and persisted verification contract. This is strong evidence that decision memory is runtime-critical data.
title: Cross-run decision reuse is tested through seed and verification fold
